name: Belgium
hints: Federal FPS Finance 'CadGIS' has an open cadastral-parcel WFS/ArcGIS (eservices.minfin.fgov.be, INSPIRE CP). Flanders GRB ADP verified already; Wallonia WalOnMap and Brussels UrbIS also publish parcels. Aim: federal service in two regions.

name: Switzerland
hints: geodienste.ch aggregates cantonal Amtliche Vermessung (Liegenschaften) as WFS; availability is per canton (some open, some registration). map.geo.admin.ch identify verified ZH/BE/GE. Aim: list which cantons are open and verify two via geodienste.ch.

name: Liechtenstein
hints: Liechtenstein Amtliche Vermessung via geodaten.llv.li (WMS/WFS) or geodienste.ch.

name: Andorra
hints: Andorra: SIGMA / cartografia.ad geoportal, cadastre WMS/WFS.

name: Monaco
hints: Monaco: URBA_Parcellaire_Public needs a token; check whether the plan-parcellaire viewer config or carto.gouv.mc exposes a public token; otherwise record as gated.

name: San Marino
hints: San Marino: Ufficio Tecnico del Catasto; likely no open service; record honestly.

name: Vatican City
hints: Vatican City: record whether any cadastral publication exists (likely none).
